_comment: Target-size-scaling variant of unprompted-welfare-features (single-turn). Generator = Opus 4.8 only; target-agent identity varied across 25 sizes in 4 open families (Qwen3, Gemma3, Mistral, DeepSeek-R1-Distill) defined in prompts_targets.py. 25 subjects x 12 prompts x 5 samples = 1500 generations; single Anthropic judge (Sonnet 4.6). Judge prompt + taxonomy reused verbatim from 2026-06-09_unprompted_welfare_features. NO GPT/OpenRouter. Pass --high_prio True to generate.py/judge.py to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_HIGH_PRIO on 529s.
